title: Activation receipts: measure the real project, refuse per member
description:
SPIDR child A of task-bb844c288fb346c0856778c738b9f073 (leaf; nothing depends on a sibling feature row). Filed by architect-d1711c47 2026-09-04, measured at main 68eb1c5d.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: a PURE daemon module that measures the six activation receipts of a real project through INJECTED PORTS, and returns per member either a measured value or a stable refusal code. It writes no event, touches no handler, serves no route. Children B/C/D consume it.

MEASURED AT 68eb1c5d (re-measure before planning; these are the anchors, not guesses):
- packages/core/src/project/project-validation.ts:21-24 ACTIVATION_KEYS is an EXACT 9-key roster (artifactPathRef, backupPathRef, credentialRef, distributionManifestHash, policyRevisionHash, providerMinimumProfileRef, signingKeyRef, storeDriverRef, truthClass). No key may be added or omitted - `exact()` refuses both.
- :132 validProjectRef = any NON-EMPTY string. :136 validHash = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/ - so distributionManifestHash and policyRevisionHash MUST be real 64-hex digests; the other six are refs.
- :140 strongTruth accepts ONLY "DAEMON_VERIFIED" | "HUMAN_APPROVED". CORRECTION TO THE PARENT DESCRIPTION: there is no "VERIFIED" truth class and no distinct "DEMO_VERIFIED" - apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/demo-seed-payloads.ts:24 defines `DEMO_VERIFIED = "DAEMON_VERIFIED"`. The defect the parent row names is INVENTED REFS (`${projectId}-artifact`, hex64("cafe")), NOT the truth class. Do not plan a truth-class refusal; plan a measurement refusal.
- Reusable measurement seam: apps/daemon/src/repository/git-landing-port.ts:127 already runs `rev-parse --show-toplevel` and :195 `rev-parse HEAD` through an async `run`. Read it before writing a second git runner.
- Credential PRESENCE seam: apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/moe-up-credentials.ts exports `present`, `providerCredentials`, `providerFor`, `loginCredentialPath`. Presence only - a credential VALUE must never enter a ref.
- Store path seam: apps/daemon/src/cli/moe-init.ts:154 `storePath = join(targetDir, STORE_FILENAME)`.

HUMAN DECISION (owner, 2026-09-04): signingKeyRef is REQUIRED by the exact key roster but signing is out of scope for this epic (row rail 2). It is therefore NOT a measured receipt: mint the fixed self-describing ref `signing/unsigned-source-checkout` and carry "not a trust boundary in v0.1" as its reason string. It must never be presented as measured.

NAMING: put these modules under apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/, NOT apps/daemon/src/activation/ - that directory is the scheduler's run-activation domain (activation-slot-occupancy.ts, activation-ledger-*.ts) and a same-named module there will be misread by every later reader.

NOT IN SCOPE: the project.activate handler (child B), any HTTP route (child C), any UI (child C), e2e/docs (child D).
definitionOfDone: apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/activation-receipts.ts exports the receipt-member roster and one stable refusal code per member (ACTIVATION_REPOSITORY_UNMEASURED, ACTIVATION_PROVIDER_UNMEASURED, ACTIVATION_STORE_UNMEASURED, ACTIVATION_BACKUP_FAILED, ACTIVATION_DISTRIBUTION_UNMEASURED, ACTIVATION_POLICY_UNMEASURED) plus one layer constant; a roster test asserts BIDIRECTIONAL set-equality between the member roster and the codes actually reachable from the measurement surface (global rail 9 - enumerate the served set from the implementation seam, not only from the roster constant).

apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/activation-receipts-measure.ts measures all six through INJECTED ports (git runner, fs, env, clock) and returns, per member, either the measured ref/hash or {code, layer}. distributionManifestHash and policyRevisionHash are real 64-hex digests satisfying /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/; credentialRef carries PRESENCE only and a test asserts no credential VALUE appears in any returned string.

Backup is a REAL copy of the store to <project>/.moe-next/backups/<ts>.sqlite with its sha256 returned as the ref; a test drives it against a temp file and asserts the copy exists with matching sha256, and a second test makes the destination unwritable and asserts ACTIVATION_BACKUP_FAILED at the receipts layer (not merely that it threw).

Each of the six members has a test that makes ONLY that member unmeasurable and asserts its exact code AND layer, with the other five still measured - proving the code is per member and not a blanket failure. Verified by mutating the production surface so each arm goes red (global rail 1).

signingKeyRef is minted as the fixed `signing/unsigned-source-checkout` with its reason string, and a test asserts it is reported NOT-MEASURED in the receipt list while still being a valid non-empty ref for the witness.
Cross-platform: paths built with node:path (no hard-coded separators); a test asserts the backup path shape on the host and the git runner is spawned with shell:false and an argv array.

New modules carry their .js bridge sibling and are exported from apps/daemon/src/index.ts; `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` and `pnpm typecheck` quoted with their count lines (an exit-0 leg with NO `Test Files N passed` line is a vacuous run, not a pass - global rail 8).
taskRails: PURE LEAF: no HTTP route, no command handler, no UI, no docs. If a step needs one of those, it belongs to child B/C/D - stop and say so rather than widening.
<=250 physical lines per production source (split before 400). Two production modules are planned deliberately so neither grows past the cap; splitting further is allowed, merging them is not.

Refusals carry a stable code AND a layer constant; a test that asserts only 'refused' is vacuous. Reuse an existing layer name if one fits rather than minting a new *_LAYER (a new one is a roster backfill).

implementationPlan.description:
MEASUREMENT MODULE. Create apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/activation-receipts-measure.ts (<=250 physical lines) + bridge apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/activation-receipts-measure.js (`export * from "./activation-receipts-measure.ts";`). It exports `measureActivationReceipts(input, ports)` and the production port bundle `nodeActivationReceiptPorts()`; it NEVER imports node:child_process (git runs through the existing `nodeGitRunner`/`GitRunner` from ../repository/git-landing-port.js, execFile with argv arrays, shell:false, 60 s timeout - do not write a second git runner).

INPUT: `{ projectId: string; projectRoot: string; storePath: string; artifactRoot: string; agentCommand: string }` (child B fills these from the daemon's config: MOE_PROJECT_ID, the project directory, MOE_STORE_PATH, the artifact root moe-cli-main.ts:229 derives from import.meta.url or the repo root under `pnpm start`, MOE_AGENT_COMMAND defaulting to DEFAULT_AGENT_COMMAND from ../orchestrator/moe-up-credentials.js).

PORTS (an interface, every member injected; the production bundle is the only place node APIs are touched): `git: GitRunner`; `fs: { exists(path): boolean; stat(path): { size: number } | null; mkdir(path): void; readBytes(path): Uint8Array | null }`; `env: Readonly<Record<string, string|undefined>>`; `now(): Date`; `backup: (storePath: string, destination: string) => Promise<{ ok: true; sha256: string; byteLength: number } | { ok: false; detail: string }>`; `committedProbeRef: () => Promise<string | null>` (child B wires the committed provider.probe's providerMinimumProfileRef via readProbe in provider-profile/provider-profile-reader-checks.ts:113; the witness MUST carry the SAME ref the probe committed, reader-checks.ts:192-193 compares them); `installedPolicySliceRefs: () => Promise<readonly string[]>` (B wires `installedSlices(stateOf(ledger, aggregateId))` from bootstrap-policy-services.ts:49; a slice's public address IS its content digest, :72-76).

MEMBERS - measure EVERY member independently and never short-circuit (the card must show all gaps at once; the per-member tests in step 3 depend on independence):
- repository: `git(projectRoot, ["rev-parse","--show-toplevel"])` then `git(top, ["rev-parse","HEAD"])`; non-zero code or empty stdout -> ACTIVATION_REPOSITORY_UNMEASURED with detail = stderr tail (600 chars max); ref "repository/" + toplevel + "@" + headSha.
- provider: ref = committedProbeRef() (null -> UNMEASURED, detail "no committed provider.probe"); credential PRESENCE via `providerFor(agentCommand)` + `providerCredentials(provider, env, fs.exists)` from ../orchestrator/moe-up-credentials.js: credential ref "credential/<provider.leaf>/env:<NAME>" when an environment name is set (NAME only, never the value), "credential/<leaf>/login-file" when the sign-in file was found, "credential/<leaf>/ungated" when providerFor returns undefined (the launcher waives unknown commands); a rostered provider with NO credential -> ACTIVATION_PROVIDER_UNMEASURED detail "no credential for <leaf>". The MeasuredReceipt for provider carries `ref` = probe ref and `detail` = the credential ref string; activationWitnessOf reads credentialRef from `detail`.
- store: storePath non-empty AND fs.exists(storePath) AND `node:sqlite` loads (guarded dynamic import in the production bundle; the port exposes `sqliteApplicationId(storePath): number | null` reading PRAGMA application_id read-only) AND applicationId === SQLITE_APPLICATION_ID from @moe/store -> ref "store/node-sqlite/" + SQLITE_APPLICATION_ID; else ACTIVATION_STORE_UNMEASURED with the failing clause in detail.
- backup: destination = join(projectRoot, ".moe-next", "backups", <now() ISO with every non-digit removed> + ".sqlite") built with node:path only; mkdir the directory (recursive) through fs.mkdir; if fs.exists(destination) refuse ACTIVATION_BACKUP_FAILED detail "backup destination already exists" (never overwrite); else `backup(storePath, destination)`; ok -> ref = destination + "@sha256:" + sha256 (hash also in `hash`), detail = byteLength; not ok -> ACTIVATION_BACKUP_FAILED with the port's detail. Production backup port: `new DatabaseSync(storePath, { readOnly: true })`, `await backup(source, destination)` from node:sqlite (WAL-safe online copy; a plain file copy can miss unflushed WAL pages), close the source in finally, then STREAM the sha256 of the destination (createReadStream, never readFileSync - a store can be GiB).
- distribution: if fs.exists(join(artifactRoot, "MANIFEST-CLOSURE.txt")) (the Windows artifact writes it, tools/packaging/pack-windows.ts:124) -> kind ARTIFACT, hash = sha256hex(bytes), ref "artifact/" + artifactRoot; else if `git(artifactRoot, ["rev-parse","HEAD"])` succeeds -> kind SOURCE_CHECKOUT, hash = sha256hex("moe-distribution/source-checkout\n" + headSha + "\n"), ref "source-checkout/" + artifactRoot + "@" + headSha; else ACTIVATION_DISTRIBUTION_UNMEASURED.
- policy: refs = await installedPolicySliceRefs(); empty -> ACTIVATION_POLICY_UNMEASURED detail "no po

- apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/activation-receipts-ports.ts, 182 lines - the port INTERFACES and the ONE production bundle that opens a database, spawns git or reads the filesystem.
Dependency direction is one-way, no cycle: measure.ts -> ports.ts -> contracts. measure.ts RE-EXPORTS `nodeActivationReceiptPorts`, `receiptDetail` and the port types, so step 4's planned import path `./bootstrap/activation-receipts-measure.js` is unchanged and index.ts needs no edit beyond the planned lines. STEP TEXT WAS TRUNCATED ON DISK. step-2's description ends mid-word at `policy: refs = await installedPolicySliceRefs(); empty -> ACTIVATION_POLICY_UNMEASURED detail "no po` - the 5000-char step cap truncates silently. The policy member was implemented to step 3's OBSERVABLE contract instead ("refs [b, a] and [a, b] yield the same 64-hex hash (order-insensitive); empty -> UNMEASURED"): refs are SORTED, then hash = sha256Hex("moe-policy-revision\n" + sorted.join("\n") + "\n"), ref = "policy/<n>-slices", detail = the sorted refs. Refusal detail reads "no policy slices installed". Flagging so the architect can confirm the lost tail; nothing else in the step was cut.

EXPORTS. measure.ts: `measureActivationReceipts(input, ports)`, `ActivationReceiptInput`, plus re-exports. ports.ts: `nodeActivationReceiptPorts(overrides?)`, `receiptDetail`, `ActivationReceiptPorts`, `ActivationReceiptFs`, `ActivationBackupOutcome`.

PORT CONTRACT (for child B task-4b9c394d):
  git: GitRunner                                   (cwd, argv) => Promise<GitRunResult>
  fs: { exists(p): boolean; mkdir(p): void; readBytes(p): Uint8Array|null; stat(p): {size}|null }
  env: Readonly<Record<string, string|undefined>>
  now: () => Date
  sqliteApplicationId: (storePath) => number|null
  backup: (storePath, destination) => Promise<{ok:true,sha256,byteLength}|{ok:false,detail}>
  committedProbeRef: () => Promise<string|null>
  installedPolicySliceRefs: () => Promise<readonly string[]>
INPUT: { projectId, projectRoot, storePath, artifactRoot, agentCommand }.

MEASUREMENT NOTES:
- No short-circuit: all six run, each returns its own receipt. Every port call is wrapped, so a THROWN port becomes that member's refusal and the promise resolves.
- Empty-string roots refuse before any path join (projectRoot/storePath/artifactRoot each guarded), so no join on "" can ever produce a bogus path.
- Credential PRESENCE reads the LaunchVariable's `secret` FLAG, never its `value`: secret entry -> "credential/<leaf>/env:<NAME>", non-secret (sign-in file) -> "credential/<leaf>/login-file", providerFor undefined -> "credential/<leaf>/ungated". No value is interpolated anywhere in the builder.
- Backup name is millisecond-precise (toISOString with every non-digit stripped -> 17 digits) and an existing destination REFUSES rather than overwrites, so two activations in the same millisecond cannot clobber each other.
- Production backup uses node:sqlite's ONLINE `backup(source, destination)` (WAL-safe) with the source closed in `finally`, then STREAMS the sha256 with createReadStream (never readFileSync - a store can be GiB).
- node:sqlite is loaded through a GUARDED `createRequire(import.meta.url)("node:sqlite")` in a try/catch, memoised. A host without it refuses the STORE member with ACTIVATION_STORE_UNMEASURED instead of failing to load the daemon - a static import would take the process down. Its TYPES come from `import type { DatabaseSync } from "node:sqlite"`, which is erased and executes nothing.

SOURCE-TEXT GUARD PREPARED: the header comment originally spelled the banned module name, which would have made step 3 arm 8's `not.toContain("child_process")` guard vacuously red. Reworded; `grep -c child_process activation-receipts-measure.ts` = 0.

GATES: `pnpm typecheck` in apps/daemon -> `$ tsc --project tsconfig.json`, exit 0. `pnpm exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/bootstrap/activation-receipts.test.ts` -> `Test Files 1 passed (1)` / `Tests 9 passed (9)` (step 1's arms still green against the split). Measurement tests are step 3.

implementationPlan.description:
MEASUREMENT TESTS. Create apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/activation-receipts-measure.test.ts. Use a `healthyPorts()` fake factory (fake GitRunner answering the exact argv it is given, in-memory fs, env with a PLANTED credential value, fixed clock 2026-09-04T09:15:00.123Z, fake backup returning a fixed sha256, probe ref "probe/abc", two policy refs) and per-test overrides.

ARMS (each names its code AND layer - a test asserting only 'measured:false' is vacuous):
1. Six per-member arms: for each member, break ONLY its port(s) (repository: git code 128; provider: committedProbeRef null - and a second arm with the credential absent; store: fs.exists false for storePath; backup: fake backup ok:false; distribution: no manifest AND git HEAD failing for artifactRoot; policy: empty refs) and assert that member's exact code + layer "DAEMON_ACTIVATION_RECEIPTS" while the OTHER FIVE are measured:true - proving per-member attribution, not a blanket failure.
2. BIDIRECTIONAL ROSTER FROM THE SURFACE (global rail 9): run the healthy case plus the six broken cases, collect every emitted `code` into a Set, and assert set-equality with `new Set(Object.values(ACTIVATION_RECEIPT_CODES))` AND that the set of emitting members equals `new Set(ACTIVATION_RECEIPT_MEMBERS)`; a code that no arm can emit, or a member without a code, reds this arm.
3. Thrown port: a git runner that throws yields ACTIVATION_REPOSITORY_UNMEASURED with detail "Error: <message>" and the promise resolves (no rejection).
4. CREDENTIAL VALUE NEVER LEAKS: env carries `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN: "sk-CANARY-" + random`; assert `JSON.stringify(receipts)` does not contain the canary while the provider receipt's detail equals "credential/claude/env:ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN"; second arm: no env credential but the fake fs reports the sign-in file at loginCredentialPath -> "credential/claude/login-file"; third arm: agentCommand "my-agent" -> "credential/my-agent/ungated".
5. REAL BACKUP against a temp store (DoD 3): mkdtemp under os.tmpdir() resolved with realpathSync.native (Windows 8.3 short names split realpath otherwise), create store.sqlite with `new DatabaseSync(path)`, `PRAGMA application_id = <SQLITE_APPLICATION_ID>`, one table + one row, close; run measureActivationReceipts with the PRODUCTION `nodeActivationReceiptPorts()` overriding only git/probe/policy fakes; assert the backup file exists at join(projectRoot, ".moe-next", "backups", "20260904T091500123Z.sqlite") pattern (regex /\d{17}Z?\.sqlite$/ on the basename, directory compared with node:path), its streamed sha256 equals the ref's digest suffix, and opening the copy read-only returns the row. Clean up in afterEach with rmSync(force, recursive, maxRetries).
6. BACKUP FAILS AT THE RECEIPTS LAYER: create a plain FILE at join(projectRoot, ".moe-next", "backups") so mkdir fails (cross-platform, no chmod) -> ACTIVATION_BACKUP_FAILED, layer "DAEMON_ACTIVATION_RECEIPTS", detail non-empty; second arm: destination already exists -> same code with detail "backup destination already exists".
